name: Sanofi S.A.
blurb: Sanofi S.A. is a major French multinational pharmaceutical and healthcare company listed on Euronext Paris under the ticker SAN. It operates across the global healthcare sector, developing, manufacturing, and marketing prescription medicines, vaccines, and consumer health products. The company is one of the largest pharmaceutical groups in Europe and ranks among the top global players by market capitalization, which stood near €107 billion based on available source data.
